build_plan.exit_criteria: One watertight printable solid; fixed 0.4 mm print preflight passes; homogeneous mass lies below the curvature center with restoring torque for small tilts.

components.duty: Provides the complete held body, contact curve and gravity restoring mass in one homogeneous solid.
components.form: One extruded circular segment with 40 mm underside radius, a chord 18 mm below the curvature center, 28 mm extrusion depth and 2 mm rounded profile corners. Plain geometric body with flat end faces.
components.interfaces: Curved underside contacts the desk. Broad top receives the finger nudge. One flat segment end lies on the print bed; no supports or hardware.
components.name: Solid rocker
components.placement: Resting on the curved underside; curvature center 40 mm above the level desk, extrusion centered across the 28 mm depth.

concept.interaction: Place the rocker on its curved underside on a level desk. Gently tip the rocker by less than 15 degrees and release. Its center of mass rises when tilted, so gravity pulls it toward level. The entire single body moves; there are no moving internal parts. Larger pushes can overturn it.
concept.summary: A palm-sized solid desk rocker. A gentle finger nudge sets its curved underside rolling, while gravity draws it back toward its level resting position.
concept.title: Quiet Arc

decisions: One solid printable component; no joints, assembly, bearings, springs, electronics or character decoration.
Uniform 100 percent infill preserves the homogeneous mass model; hollowing is rejected because mass is functional.
Gentle rocking demonstrated with exact CAD poses; damping is illustrative and no physical test is claimed.
research.evidence: cad/measure/balance.json records exact rounded-solid center of mass, restoring potential and level-plane tangency.
research.method: First-principles circular rolling geometry and exact CAD mass properties; no catalog components or sourced external specifications are used.
